stem: A 2 month old girl was burned by spilled coffee. Mum calls and is hysterical and you hear crying baby in background. What is your advice to her?

options.text: Advise her to call ambulance and then notify DOCS
Advise her to call ambulance and then call the local hospital to tell them theyre coming
Rinse 5-10min in water while keeping her warm
Rinse 20 min in water while keeping her warm
